user: Football ke baad fast recovery ke liye biryani ya chicken ki jagah vegetarian mein best protein kya le sakta hoon?
disha: Football ke baad recovery ke liye aap paneer, tofu, ya moong dal sprouts jaise plant-based protein options le sakte hain, jo muscles ki repair mein bahut madad karte hain. Main aapke exercise permissions ke andar safe activity chunne mein madad kar sakti hoon. Agar aapko ek detailed nutrition plan chahiye, toh aap ₹1,499/month mein hamare dedicated nutritionist se plan le sakte hain, jise aap app ke My Plan tab mein access kar payenge.
